text:
Talia: Quick culture poll — office breakfast emergency. We found a plate of partly-soggy toast in the kitchen. Is this a solemn crime against carbs or a quirky lunchtime blessing? React with :bread: for salvage, :no_entry_sign: for ban it forever, or reply with 🔥 for ceremonial disposal.
Mike: Salvage. Toast is a way of life. :bread: :raised_hands:
Ashley: I will 100% volunteer to be "Toast Marshal" and make new toast at the next all-hands. Fully on-brand. :chef:
Jordan: Ban it. Soggy toast gives me the heebie-jeebies. :no_entry_sign:
Sam: Could we have a tiny toaster in the kitchen? I can bring one from home. Small footprint, large morale.
dev-bot: Poll created: 1) Salvage (:bread:) 2) Ban (:no_entry_sign:) 3) Ceremonial disposal (🔥). Voting open for 24h.
Leo: Lore note — the "Soggy Pigeon" incident of '24 is still in the breakroom hall of fame. This is a slippery slope.
Anya: Vote: ceremonial disposal. We need a ritual to restore breakfast dignity. :sparkles:
Mike: Also, shoutout to Ashley for stepping up. Toast Marshal is a real job title now. :tada:
Ashley: Accepting the Toast Marshal mantle. Will bring a compact toaster and a jar of jam on Monday. Parking-lot jam only, not the artisan one. :grin:
Jordan: If there's a ceremony, can we have sashes? Toast Marshal sash. :laughing:
Sam: Toast maintenance checklist idea: tray, crumbs vacuum, jam spoon, and moisture-absorbing napkins. I can make a quick Google Doc.
Talia: Love this. Assigning Ashley the provisional Toast Marshal role until further notice. Also renaming the soggy plate to "The Soggy Pigeon" in the breakroom ledger. :memo:
Leo: Proposal: every month the Toast Marshal gets a tiny ribbon. Low-cost morale.
Anya: 24h poll update — ceremonial disposal is leading by two votes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
dev-bot: Poll closed. Results: Salvage 3, Ban 2, Ceremonial disposal 3. Tie between Salvage and Ceremonial disposal.
Talia: Tie-breaker time — final call in thread. Otherwise Ashley's toast sash goes into effect and we hold a 2-minute ceremony.
Jordan: Fine. Two-minute ceremony. But Ashley has to deliver toast samples. :ok_hand:
Ashley: Deal. I'll bring toasted samples and a tiny ceremonial bell. Does anyone have a toy bell I can borrow? :bell:
Mike: I have one on my desk. I'll drop it in the kitchen Friday morning.
Talia: Thanks team. New lore item unlocked: "The Soggy Pigeon Proclamation" — recorded for posterity. Please keep crumbs off keyboards. :crab:
